name: Tuomo Suntola
summary: Finnish inventor and physicist who developed Atomic Layer Epitaxy (ALE) and Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD).

name: Riikka L. Puurunen
summary: Author of the essay and researcher at VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland.

name: Tampere
summary: City in Finland where Tuomo Suntola was born.

name: Finland
summary: Country where Tuomo Suntola lived and worked.

name: Helsinki University of Technology
summary: University where Tuomo Suntola studied and later worked.

name: VTT Semiconductor Laboratory
summary: Research laboratory where Suntola worked on humidity sensors and early ALE.

name: Instrumentarium Oy
summary: Company where Suntola invented Atomic Layer Epitaxy.

name: Lohja Oy
summary: Company that acquired the ALE-EL project from Instrumentarium.

name: Microchemistry Ltd.
summary: Company founded by Suntola to develop ALE for solar panels and catalysis.

name: Neste Oy
summary: National oil company that owned Microchemistry Ltd.

name: ASM
summary: Dutch company that acquired Microchemistry Ltd.

name: Planar Inc.
summary: American company that acquired Lohja's EL business.

name: Beneq Oy
summary: Company that acquired Planar's EL plant in Olarinluoma.

name: Picosun Oy
summary: Company founded by Sven Lindfors where Suntola later served as board member.

name: Fortum Oyj
summary: Company formed by fusion of Neste and IVO where Suntola worked as Research Fellow.

name: Thor Stubb
summary: Professor at HUT who supervised Suntola's doctoral thesis.

name: Jorma Antson
summary: Colleague of Suntola who co-developed the Humicap sensor and ALE.

name: Sven Lindfors
summary: Close co-worker of Suntola in ALE reactor design.

name: Arto Pakkala
summary: Colleague of Suntola involved in ALE-EL development.

name: Humicap 1
summary: Humidity sensor developed by Suntola and Antson.

name: ALE reactor
summary: Equipment designed for Atomic Layer Epitaxy/Deposition processes.

name: F-120 reactor
summary: First commercial ALD reactor designed by Suntola and Lindfors.

name: FIN 52359
summary: International patent on ALE filed in 1974.

name: European SEMI Award 2004
summary: Award honoring Suntola as a pioneer in Atomic Layer Deposition.
